subject: Secure audit vault provisioning and auditor onboarding
messages:
From: Andre Wong <andre.wong@fintera.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kroll Audit Team <audit@kroll.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II - auditor access for evidence review

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well. Our third-party auditor (Kroll) will be starting the SOC 2 Type II evidence collection for the period 2027-04-01 to 2028-03-31. They need access to your secure evidence vault to pull logs, policy docs, and sampled artifacts.

Two quick questions before we schedule:
1) Do you support SAML SSO for auditors, or do you provide a one-time secure token/link?
2) What is the maximum download window (hours/days) and can you issue a bridge letter confirming the audit period?

If SSO is required we can provide the auditor name and contact list; if a one-time link is easier that works too — we typically schedule a 48-72 hour window.

Can you confirm the preferred flow and any steps we need to complete on our side?

Thanks,
Andre Wong
Head of Security Programs, Fintera
andre.wong@fintera.com
+1 415-555-0193
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Andre Wong <andre.wong@fintera.com>
Cc: Kroll Audit Team <audit@kroll.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - auditor access for evidence review

Andre — thanks for the heads up and the audit window. We can support both SAML SSO (preferred) and one-time encrypted tokens depending on the auditor's tooling. High-level options: 

- SAML SSO: We can add the auditor as a transient identity provider entry; we’ll need SAML metadata (xml) and the auditor contact list. Access will be scoped to read-only and download-enabled for the requested evidence types.
- One-time token: A time-limited, single-use HTTPS token (48h default, extendable to 72h upon request) with IP allowlist if you require.

Regarding the bridge letter: we can provide a short confirmation letter that lists the audit period and the documents available in the vault. We usually attach that to the auditor invite.

Next steps from our side:
1) Please send SAML metadata if SSO is preferred, or confirm the auditor emails for a one-time token.
2) Tell us desired start date/time for the window (we’ll try to align with your timezone).
3) Confirm whether you need an encrypted evidence export after the review.

I’m copying our compliance lead (laura_bennett) and our audit coordinator (marissa_cole) to assist with provisioning and the bridge letter.

Attachments: saml_metadata.xml (placeholder) and auditor_list.csv (if you have it).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Mar 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II - auditor access for evidence review

FYI forwarding request from Fintera (Andre).

Laura / Marissa — can you: 
- Provision a one-time encrypted token for Kroll (audit@kroll.com) valid for 48 hours, start date: 2028-03-28 09:00 PT (Fintera prefers mornings).
- Add an IP allowlist for Kroll (we’ll confirm IPs once they reply).
- Draft a bridge letter confirming audit period 2027-04-01 to 2028-03-31 and list the core evidence bundles (logs, retention policy, SOC config docs).
- If SAML SSO is requested, we’ll need to exchange SAML metadata — attached a placeholder.

Please confirm ETA. If we can do SSO instead of a token, that’s preferable from a traceability perspective.

Ben

Ben / Laura / Marissa — thanks for the quick response. Kroll confirmed SSO would be preferred but they can do the one-time token if SAML exchange takes longer.

Kroll provided the following:
- Auditor primary: Erin Morales <erin.morales@kroll.com>
- Auditor backup: audit@kroll.com
- Preferred window: 2028-03-28 09:00 PT start, 48-hour window
- IPs: 34.201.12.45, 34.201.12.46 (they can add more if needed)

A couple of asks: 
1) Can the download window include an audit-trail CSV of items downloaded by the auditor?
2) For the bridge letter, can you confirm whether the letter will also include a short statement about log retention cutover on 2027-10-01 (our compliance team will need that called out).

I’ve attached Kroll_request.pdf with the auditor's onboarding checklist. Let us know when SAML metadata is required or if you prefer we proceed with token issuance.

Best,
Andre
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Andre Wong <andre.wong@fintera.com>, Erin Morales <erin.morales@kroll.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II - auditor access for evidence review

Andre / Erin — good, we’ll proceed with SSO as first option and prepare a fallback one-time token. Action plan: 

1) Laura will prepare the bridge letter and confirm the language about the 2027-10-01 retention cutover.
2) Marissa will provision a transient SAML entry; we’ll send a test SSO link to Erin by 2028-03-27 EOD. If SSO test passes, we’ll schedule the 48h window starting 2028-03-28 09:00 PT.
3) Marissa will also enable download auditing (CSV of download events) for the auditor session and provide the audit-trail after the window closes.
4) If SSO cannot be completed, Marissa will issue a one-time token (48h) scoped to the requested evidence bundles.

We’ll provide the SAML metadata endpoint and the bridge letter draft by COB 2028-03-24.

Thanks — Ben
